title: Pallieter
summary: "Pallieter" by Felix Timmermans is a regional novel published in 1916. Set in the idyllic town of Lier, it follows the joyful Pallieter, who lives by the motto "seize the day." He spends his time wandering the Nete valley, reveling in nature's beauty with carefree abandon. When he meets Marieke during the annual fair, romance blooms. This celebration of life and simple pleasures became enormously popular during wartime, offering readers an escape into pure joie de vivre amid dark times.
